conbody.p: With the vehicle on, touch SetupVehicleDriver assistanceParking safety on the infotainment system.

li.p: Forward/Side Safety: It warns or assists in braking when there is a high risk of collision with pedestrians or objects in the forward/side direction.
Backward safety: It warns or assists in braking when there is a high risk of collision with pedestrians or objects in the rear direction.

note.p: When the vehicle and the trailer are connected electrically, Parking Collision-Avoidance Assist automatically turns off. In this case, you cannot get help from Parking Collision-Avoidance Assist. Always drive with care. (if Kia genuine part equipped)
Forward/side safety is only available when rear safety is selected. Rear safety is set as the default when the vehicle is turned on, and forward/side safety is set to the previous selection.
